PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Strategic and result-oriented Operations and Plant Head with 9.8 years of progressive experience, growing from Production Engineer to leading plant operations. Proven track record in scaling manufacturing performance, implementing ERP systems, and enhancing customer satisfaction. Successfully led operational initiatives that resulted in a 125% increase in company revenue over 4 years. Skilled in IsO compliance, lean systems, multi-skill workforce development, and cross-functional team leadership. Recognised for meticulous planning, inventory optimisation, and sustainable shop floor improvements.

CORE COMPETENCIES

- Plant Operations & Production Management
- ERP Implementation · ERP Implementation
- Budgeting & Cost Control
- Supply Chain & Inventory Optimization
- Cross-Functional Team Collaboration
- Customer Communication & Relationship Management · Customer Communication & Relationship Management
- Manpower Planning & Operator Retentior · Manpower Planning & Operator Retention
- Lean Manufacturing, 5S and Kaizen
- Quality & Compliance (ISO 9001 Standard · Quality & Compliance (ISO 9001 Standards)
- Performance Monitoring & KPI Dashboarding
- ISO & Customer Audits. · ISO & Customer Audits.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Operations and Plant Head, Avi Oilless Die Components India Pvt. Ltd. Pune, April 2021-Present

- Responsible for full plant operations, resource management, production, quality, maintenance, and dispatch.
- Increased sales revenue from ₹14 Cr to ₹31.5 Cr in 4 years by enhancing operational efficiency, delivery timelines, and quality.
- Successfully implemented ERP system (Deskera) across departments—ensuring live tracking, planning, and reporting.
- Handled ISO 9001 and customer audits as Management Representative (MR) for 5 consecutive years.
- Developed a team of multi-skilled operators and employees, improving flexibility and reducing downtime during absenteeism or shifts.
- Improved customer satisfaction index from 80% to 96%, thanks to better delivery adherence and direct customer engagement.
- Practiced meticulous planning of materials and production, resulting in higher machine utilization and minimal rework.
- Actively collaborated with cross-functional teams – Design, QA, SCM, and Sales – to meet customer demands and reduce lead time.
- Increased operator retention rate, fostering a culture of respect, upskilling, and recognition.
- Ensure compliance with EHs, statutory, and safety standards, maintaining a safe and auditready workplace.

Production Manager, Avi Oilless Die Components India Pvt. Ltd. Pune, Feb 2019-March 2021

- un t  t    ns  r nm · rework and wastage.
- Trained mid-level supervisors on process standardization and team motivation.
- Improved coordination with procurement and logistics for better material availability.
- Tracked and analyzed production KPIs (OEE, downtime, rejection rates) to identify and eliminate bottlenecks.
- Oversaw shift-wise manpower deployment and ensured efficient utilization of labour and machine hours.
- m  n  s  sa ns   ryt· for audits.
- Ensured adherence to safety standards, conducted toolbox talks and coordinated with the EHS team.

Production Engineer, Avi Oilless Die Components India Pvt. Ltd., Pune, June 2016-Jan 2019

- ae   ss it  s s  on
- Worked on cycle time reduction and tool life improvement projects.
- Assisted in the implementation of 5S and Kaizen across the unit.
- Created daily production reports and coordinated with maintenance for minimal breakdowns.
- Conducted root cause analysis for defects and suggested corrective actions.
- Collaborated with quality control to ensure adherence to in-process quality standards and first-piece approvals.
- Ensured all safety rules were followed on the shop floor, including PPE usage and machine safety.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Engineering (Mechanical Engineering) Shivaji University, Kolhapur, India, May 2015

- Achieved a 125% increase in sales revenue over 4 years as Plant & Operations Head.
- Successfully implemented Deskera ERP across all departments.
- Handled ISO audits as Management Representative (MR) for 5 consecutive years with full compliance.
- Improved customer satisfaction from 80% to 96% through better communication and ontime delivery.
